scientific_integrity: Proof by exact inverse block row norms and separate determinant recurrence; fully specified normalization, equality cases and bounds. Direct finite matrix check passed 2045 supplementary assertions. No claim of independent validation or world priority.
scientific_limitations: Only finite square integer digit-product Fourier systems with strictly positive Bernoulli product spatial masses. Does not settle arbitrary frequency families, correlated masses, infinite-measure frame existence or sharp least-singular-value asymptotics. An older equivalent inverse-block formula may remain undiscovered.
title: Local inverse-Gram law and joint optimality for weighted Cantor Fourier towers
